# The Obsidian Forge-Tombs — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **ENDURE** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Grudge-Reanimation · The Grudge:** Reanimation: at the End of Round, each Obsidian unit that is still on the battlefield rolls a D6: on a 4+ it returns 1 slain model (Class 1–2) or heals D3 MIGHT (Class 3–5). The Grudge: before the battle name 1 enemy unit as the Grudge. Obsidian units re-roll Wound rolls of 1 against it. When the Grudge is destroyed, or an enemy unit destroys an Obsidian unit, move the Grudge to that enemy unit (only one Grudge at a time).

**Gamble — Burn the Ancestor-Spark** *(risk: resource (permanent))*: When a unit is selected to Shoot or Fight: +1 Damage and [IMPALING HITS] on its weapons this activation; that unit can never reanimate again.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Grudge-Reanimation* — 1 model / D3 MIGHT back on 4+ per round. · *The Grudge* — Re-roll wound 1s vs one unit. · *Ancestor-Spark* — Once per unit per battle.

## Detachment — Immortal Shield-Wall

*Slow, unbreakable infantry blocks around objectives.*

**Detachment rule:** Gromril Shield-Wall: enemies cannot re-roll Wound rolls against Obsidian Class 1–2 units; units within 3″ of an objective reanimate on a 3+.

**Enhancements**
- **Ancestor's Shield** (+10 pts, High Thane of the Gate): The attached unit has WARD 5+.
- **Oath-Stone** (+10 pts, Obsidian Hearth-Guard): +1 CTRL per model and cannot be moved by enemy abilities.

**Stratagems**
- **Lock Shields** (1 CP) — *A unit is targeted:* Incoming PEN −1 for the attack.
- **Stand of the Ancients** (1 CP) — *A unit is charged:* It is not Rattled and gets +1 to Hit on its Retaliation Strike.
- **Magma-Tunnel Relocation** (1 CP) — *Command Phase, once per round:* An unengaged unit within 6″ of a table edge is placed within 6″ of another point on the same table edge, >8″ from enemies.

## Detachment — Grudge-Hunters

*Thunderers and hammerers marching on the Grudge.*

**Detachment rule:** Book of Grudges: against the Grudge, Obsidian units re-roll all Wound rolls (not just 1s) and get +2″ MOV toward it.

**Enhancements**
- **Grudge-Rune** (+10 pts, Grudge-Thane Champion): Re-roll all melee Wound rolls.
- **Marked in Gold** (+10 pts, Rune-Seer): The Grudge cannot gain Cover.

**Stratagems**
- **Unforgiven** (1 CP) — *The Grudge is destroyed:* Gain 1 CP and heal D3 MIGHT on the unit that destroyed it.
- **Grudge Volley** (1 CP) — *A unit Shoots the Grudge:* Its weapons gain [HAILFIRE 1].
- **Write It Down** (1 CP) — *An Obsidian unit is destroyed:* The killer becomes the Grudge AND is Rattled.

## Detachment — Rune-Forge

*Golems, engines and master-runes for one decisive round.*

**Detachment rule:** Forge-Runes: Class 3–5 Obsidian units reanimate on a 3+; the Master-Rune can be struck twice per battle (different runes).

**Enhancements**
- **Anvil of Ages** (+10 pts, Tomb-Priest): Once per round, heal D3 MIGHT on a Class 3–5 unit within 3″.
- **Rune of Fury** (+15 pts, Liquid-Gold Rune-Golem): +1 Attack in melee.

**Stratagems**
- **Strike the Rune** (1 CP) — *A unit activates:* It gains one Master-Rune effect this activation.
- **Molten Flow** (1 CP) — *A Class 3–5 unit is damaged:* Heal 1 MIGHT.
- **Rune of Wrath** (1 CP) — *A Class 3–5 unit is destroyed:* Each enemy unit within 6″ suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.
